description: Ranked passage retrieval over the paragraph index (BM25). Use a natural-language or keyword query to find the most relevant passages across books, with the book, chapter, chunk_id, citation, license and source URL for each hit. When to use: you need evidence passages for a question rather than a literal phrase match. Do not use: to verify an exact quotation (cyberlibrary_verify_quote) or to read a whole book (cyberlibrary_get_chunks). Pass lang when known (faster/more precise). Returns: {query, matched, candidates, corpus_version, results[{chunk_id, score, lang, slug, title, chapter, para, citation, url, license, snippet}]}. Note: BM25 lexical ranking; a neural semantic layer is planned.

lang.description: Optional language filter, e.g. zh-cn, en.

slug.description: Optional book slug to restrict the search.

name: cyberlibrary_search_passages
